mapper.select:
select CASH_ID cashId, ACCR_DATE anapleroticDate, ACCR_STR_DATE anapleroticCycleStartDate, ACCR_END_DATE anapleroticCycleEndDate, VAL_DATE valDate from fin_float_accrual_sche where 1 = 1
and cash_id = #{anapleroticId}

select a.base_rule_id baseRuleId, a.coefficient, a.spread_rate spreadRate, a.charge_ratio chargeRatio from FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE_DETAIL a left join FIN_CASH_INFO b on b.cash_id = a.cash_id where b.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and b.cash_type_2 = #{value}

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.OPERATION_TYPE operationType, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE mdate, FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE vdate, FIN_PRODUCT.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID pFinprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE profitType FROM FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
mapper.insert: insert into FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE (CASH_ID, ACCR_DATE, ACCR_STR_DATE, ACCR_END_DATE, VAL_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accrDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{accrStrDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{accrEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} from dual where not exists (select 1 from FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE where CASH_ID = #{cashId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and ACCR_DATE = #{accrDate, jdbcType = DATE})
mapper.select: select A.CASH_ID cashId, A.ACCR_DATE anapleroticDate, A.ACCR_STR_DATE anapleroticCycleStartDate, A.ACCR_END_DATE anapleroticCycleEndDate, A.VAL_DATE valDate from fin_float_accrual_sche A inner join fin_cash_info C on A.cash_id = C.cash_id inner join fin_product B on (c.finprod_id = B.finprod_id or c.finprod_id = B.p_Finprod_Id) where (B.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} or B.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR}) and C.Cash_Type_1 = '06' and not exists (select 1 from (select finprod_id finprod_id, happen_date trade_date from BOK_CLAWBACK_INFO_DETAIL where bookset_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} union all select deal.finprod_id,total.trade_date from trd_fin_product_deal_total total left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal on total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where total.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and (total.is_cancel = 'N' or total.is_cancel is null) and total.trade_status = '01' and total.ps = 'C16') D where D.finprod_id = B.finprod_id and D.trade_date = A.accr_date) order by ACCR_STR_DATE

select t.Open_Mode from ( select t1.Open_Mode, t1.OPEN_TYPE, rownum rn from fin_open_rule t1 left join fin_cash_info t2 on t1.cash_id = t2.cash_id where t2.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by t1.OPEN_TYPE desc )t where t.rn = 1

select fcr.IS_INITIAL from FIN_CASH_INFO fci left join FIN_CLAWBACK_CALC_RULE fcr on fcr.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID and fcr.EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{effDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') where fci.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = '06' and fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C11'
